segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: OK, Tom, let's do the sprint planning.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: We have two weeks, and the checkout redesign is still open.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Right, the payment form is done, but the mobile layout still breaks on small screens.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Then I think we should ship the redesign behind a feature flag

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: and turn it on for 10% of users first.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: A create feature flag, 10% rollout, that gives us time to watch the error rate.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Good. What about the flaky end-to-end tests? They failed three times this week.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: I'd say we freeze new features until the test suite is green.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Fine. We freeze new features until the tests pass.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: So, tasks. Tom, can you fix the mobile layout by Wednesday?

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Yes. I will fix the mobile layout by Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: And I'll set up the feature flag and the error rate dashboard.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Priya should own the flaky tests. Maya, can you ask her to fix them this week?

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Sure, I'll ask Priya to fix the end-to-end tests by Friday.
